title: EnderEye SMP
description: The Official EnderEye SMP Server, available for all players on Minecraft 1.20.x or higher. Fully customized with temperature systems, new items, mobs, and bosses.
body:
# ⛏️ Welcome player to EnderEye SMP ⛏️
## Bedrock: Just add "EnderEyeSmp" as a friend and join them! 
## Adventer 🧭
Discover our **CUSTOM** world and find new dungons and bosses as you conquer the world while battling our new bosses, mobs, and fighthing against the harsh temperatures of each season!
![World generation and custom dungeons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/94eec2812372f32b16ee531fd544b234b44df1c1.jpeg)

## Reveal 🔓
As you connect with the world, you may find certain individuals, who will task you with challanging quests. You may also find other things like custom items, enchants, features, and textures along the way while enjoying our vanilla plus expirenece! 
![One of the Quest NPCS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ada04d5b17c18217812b82c7e4761fbe1b3740e.jpeg)

## Events 🎪
We try to offer **MONTHLY** community focused events with rewards as unique items. Don't miss them!!

## Community Focused 🤝
As we grow, help us build a welcoming community that everyone can easily join and stay safe with the help of our trusted moderation team. We are also often hosting movie or other community focused events in our [Discord]:(https://discord.gg/tXtQaBB3hF).
